name: research-synthesizer
description: Synthesizes a pile of sources you paste into the chat (interview notes, articles, reports, forum threads, call notes) against your research question into an evidence-preserving brief: findings with the verbatim quotes and source ids behind them, where sources agree or disagree, a confidence per finding computed in code, what was read, and what is still unknown. It uses only the pasted text: no browsing, no outside knowledge, and links are labels it never opens. Follow-ups work on the stored brief: only the conflicts, show quotes, high-confidence findings, list sources, what the sources say about a topic, or add another source. No general questions.

skills.name: Synthesize research sources
skills.description: An evidence-preserving brief over the sources you paste: findings with quotes and [S#] source ids, agreements and conflicts, code-computed confidence, scope and unknowns, plus follow-ups on the same brief.
examples: Synthesize these 5 interviews: what do customers say about onboarding? <paste the sources>
What do the sources say about pricing?
